decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): Find why cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_emission_gate.py reds and fix it so that the proof reseals green. Keys: red:cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_emission_gate.py::test_an_emitted_watch_crosses_and_the_journal_names_the_berth, red:cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_emission_gate.py::test_a_carried_watch_with_no_spec_on_the_ticket_is_refused, red:cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_emission_gate.py::test_a_promised_probe_the_world_does_not_hold_is_refused, red:cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_emission_gate.py::test_the_gate_reads_the_watch_the_boat_STANDS_at. Root cause (one, shared by 62a8ecb673a7, 02f0e9eee497, d2a76ee449ba): patch-in-the-asker. The proof repoints ticket_file._TICKETS in its own process, but since 0c2c3f53c2be the gates' judges (crossing_named_ticket, crossing_fixme) run in a launched CodeMother, so the patch never reaches them and the fixture ticket reads as not cast. Fix: the fixture also opens inspect_wire.launch(ticket_store=<the same dir>) for its block (3e08102ef35a's named store); the in-process patch stays for emit's own in-process reads.
